title: Expense
description: A submitted business expense submitted by a consultant for review and approval by finance.

submitterId.description: User ID of the consultant who submitted the expense.

amount.description: Monetary amount. Must be greater than 0.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., GBP, EUR, USD).

receiptDate.description: ISO 8601 date when the receipt was issued (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Current workflow status of the expense.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the expense was first submitted.

internalNotes.description: Finance-only notes, typically populated when status is Changes Requested.

region.description: Geographic region or office (e.g., EMEA, DACH, Nordics).
